type.title: Title
what.ambient: A discreet animation behind the whole portal (snow, code rain, fireflies…), chosen in Appearance.
what.avatar_frame: A frame around your profile picture.
what.badge: A badge shown on your profile and next to your name.
what.booster: A sealed pack of cards drawn at random. A look you do not have yet is yours; a duplicate gives you Coins back; an item to keep goes to your reserve.
what.bundle: Every product below at once, cheaper than one by one.
what.effect: A celebration effect played when you earn rewards.
what.level_badge: A new look for your level badge, chosen in Appearance.
what.level_up: A new way to celebrate your levels, chosen in Appearance.
what.media_rescue: Saves a title the library's cleanup was about to delete: on its page, « Save this title » takes it off the list, for everyone. Your rescues wait until you use them.
what.name_style: A font and an effect for your name on your profile.
what.notification_animation: How notifications come in, chosen in Appearance.
what.notification_style: A notification shape, chosen in Appearance.
what.palette: Accent colours laid over any theme, chosen in Appearance. Try it before buying.
what.profile_backdrop: The backdrop of any compatible film or series of the library as your profile banner — unlocked once for every title.
what.profile_background: An animated background behind your profile, seen by every member.
what.profile_banner: A banner for the top of your profile.
what.project_launch: You describe a feature or a project; it opens as a proposal in the community projects, funded by members.
what.quota: Media requests on top of your quota.
what.service_access: Access to a service of the homelab: an administrator approves it and your account is created. Declined, your Coins come back.
what.special_request: A request the administrators handle by hand: you fill in a short form after buying it, and follow it in « My purchases ». Declined, your Coins come back.
what.statistic: One more statistic in Media › Statistics.
what.streak_freeze: Protects your play streak: a day you miss is covered automatically, the streak and its multiplier go on. Your freezes are shown on your progression.
what.theme: A whole theme for the portal: colours, layout, animations and sounds.
what.title: A title shown under your name on your profile.
what.widget: One more widget for your dashboard.
what.widget_option: One more setting for a dashboard widget (another chart, a longer period…).
what.xp_boost: Multiplies the XP you earn for a while, on top of streaks and events (within the portal's limit). Bought while another runs, it starts when that one ends.
